# Browser pose assets

The packaged JavaScript module and non-SIMD WebAssembly loader/binary are from
Google's `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` release 0.10.14. The pose task is the
float16 Lite model, revision 1. This directory ships the assets so a practice
session can run offline. The runtime license is included in LICENSE.

- [Pinned runtime distribution](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.14)
- [Pose Landmarker documentation and models](https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker)
- [Original model file](https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task)
- [Hand Landmarker model, float16 revision 1](https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task), loaded locally for string instruments.
